name: Hidden King's Defense
tagline: Hold the center lane against endless trooper waves and Colossus raid bosses.
summary: Co-op wave defense on Midtown. Protect the center lane from Guardian to Patron as waves scale up, with a raid boss every five waves.
description: Hidden King's Defense by Atharv24 turns Midtown's center lane into a last stand. Up to twelve defenders hold a chain of structures, from the Guardian and Walker down to the Shrines and the Patron, against trooper waves that grow every round. Every fifth wave brings a Colossus raid boss. Last hits drop Tomes that make you stronger, boss waves offer a pick of three Major Boons, and a Legendary Armory sells tier 5 items. Spend souls to repair or fortify every structure. The run ends when the Patron falls.
goal: Survive as many waves as you can

howToPlay.title: Hold the lane
howToPlay.body: Troopers march down the center lane every 20 seconds. Last-hit them to earn souls and Tomes before they reach the Guardian.

howToPlay.title: Beat the Colossus
howToPlay.body: Every fifth wave is a raid boss. Clear it to pick one of three Major Boons.

howToPlay.title: Fortify
howToPlay.body: Type /repair or /upgrade to restore or strengthen every structure, and /legendary for the tier 5 Armory.

whatsNew: First Hideout release of Atharv24's Hidden King's Defense 0.7.7. Its leaderboards stay local on Hideout.
